_comment: Search tokens for the designations src/lib/standard-search.mjs cannot parse.
A designation that yields no token carrying a number throws instead of
indexing nothing, so anything that lands here did so on a pull request that
could decide what a reader would search it by. Keys are the designation
exactly as the bibliography spells it; values are the tokens, lowercase
alphanumerics only. Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored, which is
what lets this note live in the file it documents.
